name: ch4_fig23_room_tolerance
prompt: Title (top): "ROOM의 허용 범위 판정" + smaller warm-grey "Regulatory On/Off Minimization". Draw exactly four reaction rows. Every row has a blue center dot labeled "WT", one pale blue horizontal band labeled "허용 범위", and one orange mutant diamond. In rows one and two the orange diamond lies clearly inside the band and the right badge says "변화 0" in green. In rows three and four the diamond lies clearly outside the band on opposite sides and the right badge says "변화 1" in red. At far right show a blank abstract counter headed "크게 바뀐 반응 수" with no number. FINAL RASTER OVERRIDE: make every large shape interior exactly the same uniform off-white as the background and communicate semantic color with a single-color outline only. Allow solid color only in tiny markers. Render as a stark SVG wire diagram with fills disabled, never as polished presentation art or glassmorphism. Within any object, every interior pixel must have identical RGB; a lighter center, darker edge, glow, or soft transition is total failure. HARD QA: every band, point, diamond, badge, and counter has one perfectly uniform solid fill. No gradient, highlight, lighting, transparency, glow, bevel, shadow, or tonal variation anywhere. Keep all artwork at least 120 px from every canvas edge. Visible text is restricted to the exact double-quoted strings in this prompt; no equations, row numbers, captions, logos, or other text.
